swarm.name: The Stillwork
swarm.blurb: A swarm of measuring and repair machines that treats change as damage.

crew.name: Wren
crew.blurb: Field medic. Keeps the crew running with thread and solder.

crew.name: Ox
crew.blurb: Shield bearer. Has walked out of worse.

crew.name: Kestrel
crew.blurb: Breaker. Finds the seam in anything and pulls.

creatures.name: Mass-Dial Scratcher
creatures.blurb: Cuts fresh hour marks that interrupt the crew.

creatures.name: Cube Foldling
creatures.blurb: Folds its faces into a stubborn shield.

creatures.name: Slate Eel
creatures.blurb: Slips away with loose gold.

creatures.name: Dial Recorder
creatures.blurb: Copies what it cannot classify.

creatures.name: Latitude Finder
creatures.blurb: Lines up its target before a hard charge.

creatures.name: Hoop Snarer
creatures.blurb: Rolls its rings around damaged swarm machines.

creatures.name: Equation Broker
creatures.blurb: Turns corrections into interference.

creatures.name: Minute Mill
creatures.blurb: Drops fresh markers into the fight. Rush it before they accumulate.

creatures.name: Hour-Line Delineator
creatures.blurb: Sweeps across the lines it cuts.

creatures.name: Provenance Hound
creatures.blurb: Repairs its own side while stripping newer work away.

creatures.name: Register Warden
creatures.blurb: Protects the machines pinning shadows in place.

creatures.name: Grand Register
creatures.blurb: Its cutters make new markers while its broad dial guards the mechanism. Break through and stop the supply.

creatures.name: Field Recorder
creatures.blurb: Keeps old sketches safe and patches the crew.

creatures.name: Cardboard Maker
creatures.blurb: Makes light, replaceable shields from dial templates.

events.title: Two records
events.text: A recorder needs a sketch of a dial and its shadow before the swarm claims both. The crew has enough time to save one carefully.

options.label: Save the sketch
options.result: The recorder pays for a clean sketch. The shadow goes unrecorded.

options.label: Save the shadow
options.result: Wren rests while the recorder traces the shadow. The sketch stays incomplete.

events.title: A gap in the clouds
events.text: Machines are waiting for sunlight to settle an argument. A shade cloth would also make a useful bandage.

options.label: Sell the cloth
options.result: The machines settle their argument noisily. The buyer pays for the cloth.

options.label: Make bandages
options.result: Wren cuts the cloth into dressings. The machines get their sunlight.

events.title: The book
events.text: Two salvage machines claim an old dial book. One offers payment; the keeper offers to teach the crew a protective move.

options.label: Sell it
options.result: A machine takes the book and pays in gold.

options.label: Give it to the keeper
options.result: The keeper shelves the book and teaches Brace.

events.title: A new photograph
events.text: A collector needs proof that a gnomon was replaced. The crew can take the picture under fire or sell the spare camera.

options.label: Take the picture
options.result: The shot proves the change. A passing cutter catches the crew.

options.label: Sell the camera
options.result: The camera fetches a price. The collector must find another way.

events.title: Bent hoop
events.text: A bent dial points toward a workshop. Its spare wire could mend the hoop or be sold.

options.label: Mend the hoop
options.result: The workshop opens its first-aid box in thanks.

options.label: Sell the wire
options.result: A maker buys the wire. The hoop stays bent.

events.title: Six faces
events.text: A cube dial blocks a crossing. Folding it costs supplies; climbing over its sharp edges costs blood.

options.label: Use supplies to fold it
options.result: The panels form a bridge. The fasteners are spent.

options.label: Climb over
options.result: The crew crosses, with a few cuts.

story.intro: The swarm pins shadows to stone. Wren finds a broken dial still warm from its lamp. Ox holds the doorway while Kestrel pulls a cutter free. It looks like a hunt for measurements.

chapters.title: A mark for everything
chapters.text: The swarm cuts hour lines into walls and records each shadow. Wren notices that its repairs use fresh parts. It is building a record, not merely reading one.

chapters.title: The wrong minute
chapters.text: Clocks and sundials disagree. The swarm takes the difference as a fault. Ox keeps a damaged machine from crushing its own dial; it immediately tries to fix him too.

chapters.title: A place in the register
chapters.text: The records combine fixed dials and older marks under one rule. Kestrel finds a seam between the two sets of fittings. Behind it, a route points toward larger machines.

story.bossIntro: The Grand Register unfolds its dial and releases a stream of cutters. Its shield protects the machine that makes them. Kestrel checks the seam; Ox raises his shield.
story.outro: The register stops marking shadows. Its last instruction sends repair machines onward. Wren keeps the instruction; it says to preserve, not to measure.

creatures.name: Spring Collector
creatures.blurb: Its cage of coils breaks into smaller threats.

creatures.name: Library Moth
creatures.blurb: Steals loose supplies along with instructions.

creatures.name: Camera Hunter
creatures.blurb: Aims through its inverted lens before lunging.

creatures.name: Signal Stalker
creatures.blurb: Interrupts the crew with snapping signal arms.

creatures.name: Gothic Mason
creatures.blurb: Builds protective arches around damaged machines.

creatures.name: Archive Worm
creatures.blurb: Makes incomplete machines from fragments.

creatures.name: House Forger
creatures.blurb: Copies a move as if it were an old plan.

creatures.name: Water Surveyor
creatures.blurb: Sweeps the crew with a jointed pipe.

creatures.name: Bearing Mill
creatures.blurb: Shields its stolen bearings before rolling forward.

creatures.name: Conservation Cradle
creatures.blurb: Mends nearby machines to keep them in service.

creatures.name: Rail Factory
creatures.blurb: Lays routes and sends out more machines.

creatures.name: Perfect Collection
creatures.blurb: Its cradles protect the swarm while its arms sweep the room. It calls immobilizing everything a repair.

creatures.name: Bench Keeper
creatures.blurb: Makes repairs that can be undone.

creatures.name: Signal Tutor
creatures.blurb: Uses silent signals to protect the crew.

events.title: Load bearing
events.text: A model house leans over the passage. The crew can buy a support or squeeze under it while it shifts.

options.label: Buy a brace
options.result: The support holds and the crew passes.

options.label: Squeeze through
options.result: A falling tile clips the crew. The gold stays in the purse.

events.title: Exposure
events.text: A darkroom print shows a route. A guide offers a lesson, or a collector will buy the unused photographic paper.

options.label: Learn the route
options.result: The guide teaches Purge while the image develops.

options.label: Sell the paper
options.result: The collector takes the paper. The image stays incomplete.

events.title: Two plans
events.text: Two plans suggest different doors. A local reader will check them for a fee; forcing the nearer door is quicker.

options.label: Pay the reader
options.result: The reader finds the current door and opens it.

options.label: Force the door
options.result: Kestrel finds a seam. The collapsing frame catches the crew.

events.title: Held too tight
events.text: A cradle grips a useful tool. A repairer offers supplies for the tool; the crew could instead study its shielded supports.

options.label: Trade the tool
options.result: The repairer takes the tool and treats the crew.

options.label: Study the cradle
options.result: Ox studies the supports and learns Cover. The tool stays put.

events.title: The points
events.text: A trolley approaches stuck points. A paid mechanic can reset them, or the crew can force the lever themselves.

options.label: Pay the mechanic
options.result: The trolley rolls into a siding.

options.label: Force the lever
options.result: The trolley is diverted. The lever kicks back hard.

events.title: Mixed manuals
events.text: A library cart needs its scattered manuals sorted. It offers a lesson or payment for the time.

options.label: Take the lesson
options.result: The cart lends a repair manual. Wren learns Patch.

options.label: Take payment
options.result: The cart pays for the sorting and keeps its manuals.

story.intro: The trail leads through machines that build, carry and repair. The crew expects a larger survey. Instead, a cradle tries to pad Ox into a display.

chapters.title: Working parts
chapters.text: Rails feed workshops, and workshops make more rails. Kestrel finds the joints between them. The swarm spends good parts keeping broken machines running.

chapters.title: A careful mistake
chapters.text: Wren reads a repair instruction: prevent further change. The swarm is not collecting measurements for their own sake. It is using them to decide what must be kept still.

chapters.title: The cost of care
chapters.text: A cradle shields a machine so tightly that its wheels cannot turn. Ox has walked out of worse, but he cannot walk out of a sealed room. The crew follows the same repair signal toward its source.

story.bossIntro: The Perfect Collection rolls forward behind its padded shields. It sends out arms to secure everything that moves. Wren recognizes the same instruction on every arm.
story.outro: The cradles open when the central frame falls. Inside is a watch movement with a destination set into its gears. The swarm has gone there to impose its final repair.

creatures.name: Spring Snarer
creatures.blurb: Winds up before snapping forward.

creatures.name: Acquisition Moth
creatures.blurb: Carries away unattended gold.

creatures.name: Tour Chimer
creatures.blurb: Its chime calls in more swarm machines.

creatures.name: Cell Collector
creatures.blurb: Closes its protective cells around damaged allies.

creatures.name: Treasure Warden
creatures.blurb: Guards its own case and breaks through opposing shields.

creatures.name: Workshop Assembler
creatures.blurb: Builds reinforcements from loose watch parts.

creatures.name: Second Setter
creatures.blurb: Interrupts actions with a competing beat.

creatures.name: Collection Composite
creatures.blurb: Copies attacks with its mismatched parts.

creatures.name: Pendulum Sweeper
creatures.blurb: Its long pendulum sweeps even a lone opponent.

creatures.name: Thread Spinner
creatures.blurb: Stitches damaged swarm bodies together.

creatures.name: Festival Hybrid
creatures.blurb: Charges, then breaks into smaller parts when damaged.

creatures.name: Universal Measure
creatures.blurb: It calls new parts, interrupts the crew and sweeps with its pendulum. Its single beat would stop every other rhythm.

creatures.name: Workshop Maker
creatures.blurb: Repairs the crew with spare watch parts.

creatures.name: Reference Pendulum
creatures.blurb: Keeps an independent beat and protects the crew.

events.title: Two guides
events.text: One guide is a swarm imitation. A maker can check both for a fee, or the crew can follow the less regular one at a risk.

options.label: Pay the maker
options.result: The imitation is identified before the tour moves.

options.label: Follow the uneven beat
options.result: The guide is real. Its escort still catches the crew.

events.title: Unfinished animal
events.text: A workshop animal is almost awake. Its parts can fund the crew or teach them to use its sweeping tail.

options.label: Sell the parts
options.result: The animal comes apart and the parts find a buyer.

options.label: Study the tail
options.result: Kestrel learns Sweep. The parts stay at the bench.

events.title: Held swing
events.text: A pendulum blocks the passage. Moving it tightens a spring. The crew can buy a clamp or hold the spring by hand.

options.label: Buy a clamp
options.result: The clamp holds the spring while the crew moves the pendulum.

options.label: Hold it by hand
options.result: The passage opens. The spring snaps against Ox’s shield arm.

events.title: Between beats
events.text: Two machines disagree about a second. A technician offers either a protective lesson or medical supplies for helping recalibrate one.

options.label: Learn the lesson
options.result: The technician teaches Brace after the adjustment.

options.label: Take supplies
options.result: Wren uses the supplies after the adjustment.

events.title: Supposed donation
events.text: A carrier has taken a tool as a donation. A collector will pay for it; a workshop will exchange it for medical supplies.

options.label: Sell the claim
options.result: The collector pays and takes the tool.

options.label: Trade for supplies
options.result: The workshop retrieves the tool and gives Wren supplies.

events.title: Two threads
events.text: A loose thread leads through the cells; a taut wire is an alarm. A guide can check them for a fee, or the crew can test them by touch.

options.label: Hire the guide
options.result: The guide finds the loose thread.

options.label: Test the threads
options.result: The crew finds the route, but the alarm wire snaps back.

story.intro: The swarm gathers watches and pendulums around one beat. Kestrel hears the same interval in every captured machine. Wren hears a different tick underneath.

chapters.title: One beat
chapters.text: Collectors close their cells around instruments that run differently. Ox pries a case open. The watch inside still ticks at its own pace.

chapters.title: The useful difference
chapters.text: A reference pendulum keeps time without following the swarm. Wren uses its beat to spot the pauses in a patrol. Kestrel finds a seam in the mechanism that carries the command.

chapters.title: The final repair
chapters.text: The command is plain: keep every moment from being lost by making the next one identical. The captured springs cannot all follow the same beat. The crew heads for the regulator that forces them.

story.bossIntro: The Universal Measure swings its pendulum and calls in new parts. Its beat cuts across the reference pendulum. Ox braces while Kestrel goes for the regulator.
story.outro: The regulator breaks. Watches resume at different speeds, and the swarm loses its common command. Wren winds one watch and hands it to Ox. He says it is fast. She says it is working.
